greeting: Welcome to FandomVerse! I am VerseBot, your portal guide across Anime, Gaming, Movies, TV, K-Pop, Comics, and Manga. What can I explore with you today?
prompts: Who is the strongest character in Anime?
What gaming conventions are coming up?
Where can I find One Piece merchandise?
Tell me about Denis Villeneuve's Dune.
How does the bookmarking system work?

rules.response: In our **Anime & Manga** rosters, legends like **Son Goku** (Ultra Instinct), **Monkey D. Luffy** (Gear 5 Sun God Nika), and **Satoru Gojo** (Six Eyes & Limitless) stand at the peak! Explore full biographies, combat power traits, and series overviews in our Character Profiles!

Major gaming conventions on our calendar include **Gamescom 2026** in Cologne, Germany, and **Tokyo Game Show (TGS)** in Chiba, Japan! Check out iconic gaming champions like Geralt of Rivia, Kratos, and Link in our database.

Our **Merchandise Showcase** features officially styled apparel and collectibles, including the **Straw Hat Pirates Oversized Hoodie**, **BTS Official Lightstick**, and **Witcher 3 Silver Sword Replica**. You can add items to your temporary cart to calculate total billing amounts!
Check out our Featured Articles exploring Denis Villeneuve's **Dune: Part Two**, plus watch high-definition video trailers for upcoming blockbusters in our Trailers theater!
K-Pop fans can discover detailed artist profiles for **RM**, **Jennie**, **Felix**, **Karina**, and **Jungkook**, plus festival schedules for **MAMA Awards** and **KCON Worldwide**!

You can bookmark your favorite characters, articles, events, and merchandise items across all 7 categories by clicking the star ribbon icon. Your bookmarks are saved in LocalStorage, and you can add private session notes in SessionStorage!

fallback: I'm your all-in-one guide to Anime, Gaming, Movies, TV, K-Pop, Comics, and Manga! Ask me about character lore, upcoming fan conventions, or fan merchandise.
